facts.fact: 2424.mg reports, citing the timetable shared by Djibouti Telecom, a consortium member, that the DARE1 cable will be extended with a 3,200-3,500 km segment landing in Tanzania, Mozambique, Madagascar (Mahajanga and Toliara) and South Africa (Mtunzini), with works to start in 2026 and service in 2028; no signed agreement is described.
